# Psalm 141 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 141:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-psalm of-David. O-YHWH I-have-called-you; hasten to-me; give-ear to-my-voice when-I-call to-you.
- **LOGOS:** A Psalm of David. O LORD, I call upon you; hasten to me! Give ear to my voice when I call to you!
- **PNEUMA:** A psalm of David. LORD, I'm calling out to you — hurry! Listen to my voice when I cry out to you!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 141:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Set O-YHWH a-guard to-my-mouth; keep-watch over-door-of my-lips.
- **LOGOS:** Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, put a guard at my mouth! Watch over the door of my lips!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 141:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Are-thrown-down by-sides-of the-rock their-judges; and-they-will-hear my-words for they-are-pleasant.
- **LOGOS:** When their judges are thrown over the cliff, then they shall hear my words, for they are pleasant.
- **PNEUMA:** When their leaders are thrown down from the cliff, people will realize my words were true.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 141:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Like-one-plowing and-breaking in-the-earth, are-scattered our-bones at-mouth-of Sheol.
- **LOGOS:** As when one plows and breaks up the earth, so shall our bones be scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
- **PNEUMA:** Our bones are scattered at the edge of the grave, like dirt turned up by a plow.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 141:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Keep-me from-hands-of the-trap they-have-set for-me, and-from-snares-of doers-of iniquity.
- **LOGOS:** Keep me from the trap that they have laid for me and from the snares of evildoers!
- **PNEUMA:** Protect me from the traps they've set for me and from the snares of evildoers.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 141:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Let-fall in-his-own-nets the-wicked, together — while-I pass-by.
- **LOGOS:** Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by safely.
- **PNEUMA:** Let the wicked get caught in their own nets — while I walk safely past.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
